description: This is a shell script used for testing the support of the 'diff' format verbose submodule difference in git diff. It includes setup for testing git submodules, various test cases for diffing submodules in different states, encoding checks, nested submodules, and handling of submodule changes such as addition, modification, deletion, and type changes.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds files to a git repository with specified names, commits them, and returns the short hash of the latest commit.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Commits pending changes with a message indicating the files involved.

methods.name: diff_cmp
methods.description: Compares two diff outputs after filtering index hashes for normalization.
